one_month_reasoning: Inside the window: Q3-26 results, expected ~Tue 2026-10-20 (Vicor reports on the third Tuesday; source 35). Revenue is pre-announced at >30% q/q (>$186M; Vicor release 2026-09-30, source 37), which corrects the stale >20% figure I used in round 1, so the headline is known. What moves the stock is (a) the first split of the ~$29M+ VPD royalty into back-royalty vs run-rate, (b) the Q4 guide, (c) product gross margin (~47% in Q2) and backlog vs $380M. My central run-rate (~$17.5M/qtr) is below what a bullish read of the Q3 number implies, so the disclosure skews slightly negative for a stock that ran from ~$184 before the licence to $306, with Form 144 insider sales on Oct 1-2 (source 11). Hyperscaler Q3 capex calls in late October are a mild positive. I centre the month at ~$300 (slight reversal tilt) with ~28% one-month log-sd (95% annual vol / 3.5 plus an earnings-day jump), roughly symmetric in log space.

fair_value.method: Blend of NTM P/E (30x Oct-2027 NTM recurring EPS ex-interest $5.95 + $9.7 net cash = $188.2, weight 0.625) and a DCF ($144.3, range $126.5-168.5, weight 0.375; D&A 4.2% of revenue per the H1-26 10-Q, stated by the citation gate 2026-10-06): 0.625 x 188.2 + 0.375 x 144.3 = $171.7 -> $172. Recurring product + royalty earnings only; interest income is excluded because net cash is added. The fixed $60M licence (recognition ends Q3-27), the 2025 $45M settlement, the Q3-26 VPD back-royalty and 2026 tax benefits are excluded, and a 40% chance of renewing the two-year licence is included as $12M of 2028 royalty. The EV/EBITDA method was dropped on 2026-10-06 because no source gives peer forward EV/EBITDA.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM (Oct-2027) recurring EPS ex-interest $5.95 x 30x = $178.5 + $9.7/share net cash = $188.2; CY2027 peer median fwd P/E 26.0x (10 peers, finviz)

inputs_detail.derivation: The July call guided Q3 revenue up 'nearly 10%' (~$157.7M on Q2 $143.35M) and gave no royalty figure. Implied Q3 royalty ~$20M is my derivation ($15.4M legacy run-rate + $5M fixed-licence recognition per the CFO), so product ~$137M. >$186M less $137M product less $20M = >= ~$29M from the 2026-09-16 VPD licence.

The licence was signed 2026-09-16, two weeks before quarter-end. Two weeks of licensee sales cannot produce ~$29M, so most of Q3 is back-royalty. I take ~60% of the Q3 amount as the quarterly run-rate (range $10-30M), lower than the supervisor's $20M because no terms are disclosed and the 10-Q policy books usage royalties as the licensee sells. Grows ~20% in 2028 with AI volumes.
Q1-26 royalty $15.0M and Q2 $30.4M less $15M fixed licence = ~$15.4M/qtr legacy run-rate.

inputs_detail.derivation: Excluded from capitalised EPS; its cash is in net cash. Renewal around late 2027 treated as a 40% chance of ~$30M/yr, i.e. $12M expected 2028 royalty (judgment).

2026 = H1 $210.9M + Q3 ~$137M + Q4 ~$145M. Backlog $379.7M (+26% q/q). +35% in 2027 within Fab-1 capacity, +32% in 2028 as Fab-2 starts and Gen-2 VPD ramps; peers (MPWR Enterprise Data +164% y/y, Infineon AI power EUR1.5B->2.5B, in allocation) confirm demand; share risk vs MPS, Infineon-Delta and ADI-Empower.
Q2-26 gross margin $83.1M (58.0% of $143.4M, Q2 release); less $30.4M ~100%-margin royalty = $52.7M on $112.9M product = 46.7%. Utilisation lifts it (mgmt). Cut from round-1 55%/57%.
Q2-26 opex $48.2M (+6.1% q/q, legal costs) annualised ~$193M, grown for Fab-2 start-up, R&D and litigation.

Q2-26 other income $4.0M (10-Q) is mostly interest on ~$450M cash. Net cash (~$9.7/share) is added separately in the P/E method, so interest on that cash is left out of EPS to avoid counting the cash twice (citation fix 2026-10-06).
Q2 ETR -27.9% from option-exercise benefits is not sustainable; normalise to 20%.
Forecast, not reported. Reported: Q2-26 diluted 47.7M (basic 46.1M = 34.39M common + 11.72M Class B, 10-Q cover; finviz's 34.38M is common only); $150M buyback offsets SBC.

(Product GP + recurring royalty - opex) x 0.8 / diluted shares, interest income excluded: 2027 $4.63 - $15M x 0.8 / 48.0M = $4.38; 2028 $6.72 - $15M x 0.8 / 48.3M = $6.47; NTM = 0.25 x 4.38 + 0.75 x 6.47 = $5.95. Consensus CY2027 $6.35 (finviz) includes fixed licence, back-royalty and tax benefits.

$453.6M cash at 2026-06-30 (10-Q), no borrowings, + $14.3M CHIPS refund (Q2 call), + ~$300M operating cash flow to Q3-27, - ~$200M Fab-2 capex, - ~$100M buybacks (all forecasts except the cash and the refund). Interest on this cash is excluded from EPS.

10-peer median 26.0x on finviz next-FY (CY2027) basis, range 19.1-41.1x. 30x is ~15% over the median and inside the range: VICR's recurring EPS growth (~48%, 2027->28 ex-interest) is ~1.5x the peer median next-year EPS growth (~30%), its backlog is booked through Fab-1 capacity into 2027, and ~25% of gross profit is ~100%-margin royalty backed by ITC exclusion orders. Held below MPWR (41x) for customer concentration, a capacity cap until Fab-2, and two-year licences that reprice in late 2027.

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: Valued at Oct-2027: revenue $1.04B (2028) to $2.25B (2032) (2027 base ~$827M), EBIT margin 33%->38% (linear), tax 20%, D&A 4.2% of revenue (H1-26 10-Q ratio), capex 15%->8% of revenue (linear), working capital 15% of incremental revenue, WACC 10.5%, terminal g 4%, + $470M net cash, 48.3M shares: $144.3 (range $126.5 at 11%/3.5% to $168.5 at 10%/4.5%). Previously $158 (range $138-184) with no D&A add-back stated; the stated inputs give $120 without D&A (citation gate 2026-10-06).

inputs_detail.derivation: From my 2028 build; approaches mgmt's $2.5B target only by ~2033 given Fab-2 timing.

High beta, 95% realised vol, customer concentration.

inputs_detail.value: 4.2% of revenue ($43.7M in 2028 rising to $94.5M in 2032)
inputs_detail.derivation: H1-26 depreciation and amortization $10.760M (10-Q cash-flow statement) / H1-26 total net revenues $256.321M = 4.2%, held at that ratio (the same basis agent_3 uses). FCF = EBIT x 0.8 + D&A - capex - 0.15 x revenue change: 2028 $130.3M, 2029 $200.6M, 2030 $300.2M, 2031 $420.1M, 2032 $553.5M; PV at 10.5% = $1,122.4M; TV $553.5M x 1.04 / 0.065 = $8,856M, PV $5,375.6M; EV $6,497.9M + $470M = $6,967.9M / 48.3M = $144.3. The previously stated $158 needed ~6.6% of revenue in unstated D&A; with none it is $120.0.

bear.story: The Q3 VPD royalty proves mostly back-payment (run-rate <$10M/qtr); the late-2027 renewals of the two-year licences reprice down; AI power sockets keep going to MPS, Infineon-Delta and now ADI-Empower; Gen-2 VPD slips into 2028; 337-TA-1484 is adverse or delayed; or 2027 AI capex digests. NTM recurring EPS ~$4.8 x ~25x (peer median) + cash.

base.story: Product +35% within Fab-1 capacity, product GM ~52-55%, recurring royalties ~$130-160M, Gen-2 VPD ramps H2-27 and the ITC case advances. NTM recurring EPS ex-interest ~$5.95. The market pays ~34x plus ~$9.7 net cash (~$212), about 4 turns more than my 30x fair-value multiple, because AI-power names have held premiums for a year. That is partial persistence of today's ~62x recurring multiple, not all of it.

bull.story: Favourable 337-TA-1484 final determination (USITC target date 2027-09-20), renewal of the two-year licences at higher rates and new hyperscaler/OEM licences take recurring royalty to $250M+; Gen-2 VPD wins next-gen GPU/TPU sockets; Fab-2 on track: ~$8.5 NTM EPS x ~47x.

comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: A ~15% premium (smaller than round 1's ~30%) rests on things that should last through Oct-2027. (1) Growth: NTM recurring EPS growth ~45% (2027->28) against a peer median next-year EPS growth of ~30%, with $380M backlog (+145% y/y) already booked against Fab-1 capacity. (2) Mix: ~25% of gross profit is ~100%-margin royalty under ITC exclusion orders. It is held well below MPWR because majority Advanced Products revenue comes from one or a few customers (10-K), Vicor lost the H100 socket to MPS, ADI acquired Empower (agreement 2026-05-19, completion announced July 2026), Infineon-Delta co-develop VPD, product GM (~47%) is below MPWR's, and the royalty base reprices with the two-year licences in late 2027. No sell-side outperform call was used. Net cash is added per share in the P/E method and is not a premium reason (removed 2026-10-06 to avoid a double count).

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$145, about 21% under the $184 pre-licence close of 2026-09-16 and ~23x my NTM recurring EPS ex-interest of $5.95 net of cash, the market would be pricing a failed licensing leg: the VPD royalty proving mostly back-payment, the two-year licences renewing lower, or an adverse 337-TA-1484 outcome. It would also price product backlog falling below ~$300M or Gen-2 VPD losing next-gen sockets. That is a fundamental break, not 95%-vol noise. My bear scenario ($130) sits below it.

reasoning: Round 2 corrections: Q3-26 was guided >30% q/q (>$186M) on 2026-09-30 (source 37), not the >20% I used. The July call's ~10% guide with royalty ~$20M implies Q3 product ~$137M, so the Sep-16 VPD licence adds >= ~$29M in Q3. That is far above my round-1 $5-8M/qtr run-rate. Because the licence was signed two weeks before quarter-end, most of Q3 is back-royalty, so I set the run-rate at ~$17.5M/qtr (range $10-30M), slightly below the supervisor's $20M. I re-checked the fixed licence schedule on the call: recognition ends Q3-27, so it is excluded, and renewal is carried as a 40% option. I lowered product GM to 52%/55% from the Q2 ~46.7% base. Recurring EPS is $4.63 (2027) and $6.72 (2028), NTM $6.20 at Oct-2027 (round 1: $5.71). Comps moved to one finviz CY2027 basis (10 US peers, median 26.0x; I spot-checked MPWR 41.08, VRT 27.56, AEIS 19.57, ADI 25.16 and POWI 29.23, all matching the supervisor). The multiple fell from 36x to 30x (~15% premium) and the DCF now carries Fab-2 capex and working capital. Methods give $196 / $229 / $158, so fair value is $192, down from $213. Industry evidence confirms strong demand: MPWR, Infineon in allocation, and ADI signed a definitive agreement to buy Empower on 2026-05-19 (ADI 8-K) and announced completion in July 2026, which hardens VPD competition. Scenarios: bear $130 (25%), base $220 (50%), bull $410 (25%, down from 30% per supervisor). The base sits ~15% above fair value because I let the market keep ~34x rather than my 30x at the horizon. As a lognormal mixture (widths 0.28-0.38) the ladder has median ~$224, mean ~$257 and P(>= $306) 0.27. I am more bearish than the supervisor's 0.36 because my fair value is $192 and a +525% one-year move with insider selling argues against assuming today's multiple holds. Research limits: no VICR-specific 2027 consensus beyond finviz EPS next Y; Infineon and Delta lack a CY2027 multiple on the same source. Citation fix 2026-10-06: interest income (~$15M/yr) was in capitalised EPS while net cash was also added, a double count; EPS is now ex-interest ($4.38 / $6.47 / NTM $5.95), P/E method $188.2. The EV/EBITDA method ($229) was dropped because its 23.6x peer median was not a sourced forward EV/EBITDA. Fair value $192 -> $177 (0.625 x P/E + 0.375 x DCF $158); 12-month ladder shifted by the same proportion; base scenario $212. Citation gate 2026-10-06: the DCF had no stated D&A add-back and its $158 did not follow from the stated inputs; with D&A at the 10-Q ratio (4.2% of revenue) it is $144.3, fair value $172, ladder shifted by 172/177.
